diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with its incircle, centre I, touching AB at D, BC at E and CA at F. The dashed segment AI meets the incircle at the red point K; the gray chord DF and the blue segments DK and FK are drawn. Dashed gray segments from B and C to I meet the incircle at two further red points.

difficulty_rationale: Requires guessing that the incentre is where AI meets the incircle and proving it with the tangent-chord angle; a meaningful insight.
